Originally published @September 27, 2021

A working list of things I’ve found useful in creating my own joy and success.

  1. Bias towards action. Stop thinking & start doing + learning from experience.
  2. Cherish quality time with loved ones.
  3. Sharpen your mind with meditation.
  4. Breathe with your belly.
  5. Move—get your heart beating faster, and lungs pumping, for just 15 minutes daily.
